original_title: ARCADE: Ultimate Vehicles Pack – Low Poly Cars
title: 街机：终极车辆包–低保利汽车
original_content:
A huge set of beautiful environment models all made in a distinctive geometric polygonal art style. Designed to make your game stand out from the crowd.
Over 90 prefabs, all set up with collision and ready to be dropped into your scene.
3 separate example scenes showcasing summer, winter and desert environments.
3 Skyboxes
10 Buildings
23 Rocks
5 Clouds
18 Terrain Pieces
32 Trees
Animating Godrays
Dust and Snow particles
content:
一大批美丽的环境模型，均采用独特的几何多边形艺术风格。 旨在让您的游戏在人群中脱颖而出。
超过90个预制件，所有预制件都设置了碰撞，并准备好放入场景中。
展示夏季、冬季和沙漠环境的3个独立示例场景。
3个天空盒
10座建筑物
23块石头
5朵云
18块地形碎片
32棵树
动画Godrays
灰尘和雪粒
